Broad group. Exhibit D General column shows it is Charges for Services 406,924 + Interest 369,503 + Miscellaneous 75,180. Charges are the largest part (48%) but not a majority; interest is 43%.

Exhibit D Road column (p4) shows Charges for Services 1,426 + Miscellaneous 32,288. Miscellaneous is 96%, so under the dominant-category rule this should be other / miscellaneous revenue, not charges for services.
Schedule 3 (pp10-11) shows it is mostly Highway Bridge Buyback 105,844 and Wireless 911 39,711 (state programs), plus Visitor's Promotion 15,715. other state aid looks like the better fit.

The combined total includes KENO fund receipts of 3,965 (Schedule 3, p11), which would be keno/lottery if itemized. Recording the combined Total column is allowed for more than 6 funds; this is noted for review only.
